name: Sessions
description: Your agent sessions as the Claude Code desktop app lists them: filter by status, project or environment, and group by project.

scopes.agent_chat:read: Read your agent sessions: title, state, project, machine and times.
scopes.workspace:read: Know which workspace is open, to mark its session.
scopes.workspace:write: Show a session's workspace when you click it.
scopes.actions:run: Open a session that has no workspace in a new tab.
